_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every benefit dollar figure the site displays or computes with (Decision D4). Page prose, MDX components, and stateless tools all import from this file — no benefit figure is ever hard-coded elsewhere.
_meta.rule: every consumer of a benefit figure imports THIS file
_meta.conventions: Current-year entries carry value:null until verified against sourceUrl (verifiedAsOf set on verification). Entries prefixed _2025_ are known prior-year reference figures for context and test fixtures — never display them as current. Refresh events and SOPs live in content-ops/refresh-calendar.yaml (ssa-cola-oct, ssi-fbr-jan, ihss-wages-jan).

ssi_fbr_individual.note: SSI federal benefit rate, individual, monthly. VERIFY against SSA before calculator launch.

ssi_fbr_couple.note: SSI federal benefit rate, eligible couple, monthly. VERIFY against SSA before calculator launch.

ssi_child_allocation.note: Deeming allocation per ineligible child in the household (equals couple FBR minus individual FBR). VERIFY against SSA before calculator launch.

_2025_ssi_fbr_individual.note: Known 2025 figure — reference and test fixtures only, never display as current. Re-verify against sourceUrl before citing on any published page.

_2025_ssi_fbr_couple.note: Known 2025 figure — reference and test fixtures only, never display as current. Re-verify against sourceUrl before citing on any published page.

_2025_ssi_child_allocation.note: Known 2025 figure (1450 - 967) — reference and test fixtures only, never display as current. Re-verify against sourceUrl before citing on any published page.

ssi_general_exclusion.note: SSI $20 general income exclusion (20 CFR 416.1124(c)(12) / 416.1112(c)(4)). Statutory, not year-keyed — [TBC] verify once against eCFR during the founder edit that verifies the FBRs; the calculator cannot run before that pass anyway (FBRs ship null).

ssi_earned_exclusion.note: SSI $65 earned income exclusion (20 CFR 416.1112(c)(5)). Statutory, not year-keyed — [TBC] verify once, same pass as above.

ihss_wage_table.note: IHSS provider wages vary by county (58 counties) and change on different dates; the site links out to the CDSS table rather than mirroring it. [TBC] Confirm this CDSS URL still resolves before first use. If we ever embed per-county rates, they go here keyed by county with their own verifiedAsOf.
